MCP_LOG_MAX_MB.description: Session size limit in MB (warning on exceed)

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Your GitHub Personal Access Token with public_repo scope

servers.description: ToolMesh is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted MCP gateway written in Go that sits between AI agents and backend systems. It enforces a fail-closed pipeline on every tool call, including per-tool and per-user authorization, server-side credential injection, structured audit logging, and output policies. APIs are declared in YAML with DADL, turning REST endpoints into MCP tools without writing a custom MCP

LOG_LEVEL.description: Structured logging level (debug, info, warn, error). Set to 'info' or higher for production.

OPENFGA_MODE.description: Authorization mode: 'bypass' (default, no authz checks) or 'restrict' (OpenFGA enforcement).

TOOLMESH_API_KEY.description: API key for programmatic access. Alternative to TOOLMESH_AUTH_PASSWORD for single-key setups.

TOOLMESH_AUTH_PLAN.description: Identity plan when using TOOLMESH_AUTH_PASSWORD or TOOLMESH_API_KEY fallback.

TOOLMESH_AUTH_USER.description: Identity username when using TOOLMESH_AUTH_PASSWORD or TOOLMESH_API_KEY fallback.

TOOLMESH_AUTH_ROLES.description: Identity roles when using TOOLMESH_AUTH_PASSWORD or TOOLMESH_API_KEY fallback.

TOOLMESH_MCP_TIMEOUT.description: HTTP client timeout in seconds for calls to downstream MCP servers.

TOOLMESH_EXEC_TIMEOUT.description: Tool execution timeout in seconds (context deadline for backend calls).

TOOLMESH_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Password for single-user authentication. Without it, all requests are rejected unless TOOLMESH_API_KEY is set or users/API keys are configured via YAML files.

servers.name: ToolMesh
